solves.reason: 본문: went on a hike alone / temperature was dropping quickly / battery was nearly dead → alone-dropping-dead
본문: take a wrong turn and get lost / climbed up to a higher spot / quality was poor → lost-higher-poor
본문: spent one night in difficult conditions / infer Compean's approximate location / Kuo's unusual skills → difficult-approximate-unusual
본문은 'found a weak signal'인데 ④가 strong으로 반대. 나머지 missing/wrong/deep은 본문과 일치
본문은 'a recent forest fire had destroyed some signs'인데 ③이 built로 반대. 나머지는 본문과 일치(safe/experienced/planned)
본문은 'the police worried about his spending a second night'인데 ③이 relaxed로 반대. 나머지는 shared/immediately/recognized 일치
'sent a picture to show his surroundings' — 사진으로 자신의 주변 환경을 보여줌
'find out if anyone could find clues in the picture' — 사진에서 단서를 찾다
'when he saw the picture of Compean, he was immediately interested' — 흥미를 느낌
recently(최근에) = lately. rarely/barely/hardly는 '거의 ~않다'로 의미 다름
examining(조사하다, 살펴보다) = inspecting(점검하다, 조사하다)
infer(추론하다) = deduce(추론하다)
final(마지막의) ↔ first(처음의)
difficult(어려운, 힘든) ↔ easy(쉬운)
(A) 위성사진 비교 후 찾은 match=일치, (B) 축구 시합 match=경기 → 일치-경기
'a deep, narrow valley with steep rocky sides' = canyon(협곡)
'it __________ him of a recent forest fire' — it(=검댕)이 주어, 과거 시제 문맥(saw, was)이므로 remind→reminded
'the area __________ by Kuo' — area가 indicate 당하는 대상이므로 과거분사 수동형 indicated
'wrote SOS on the ground __________ a plane or helicopter passed by' — 대비하여(in case)
'couldn't get a signal. __________, its battery was nearly dead' — 설상가상으로(To make matters worse)
